reply_text:
Found one merge-blocking issue:

*P1 — `topTags` mutates the input array* — `src/tags.js:10`
`tags.sort(...)` reorders the caller’s array in place. `sidebar()` calls it before taking the recent strip (`src/render.js:4–5`), so “recent” becomes the five highest-count tags instead of the first five supplied. This also violates the documented non-mutation contract.

*Recommended fix:* Sort a copy: `[...tags].sort(...)`. Add regression tests asserting that `topTags` preserves its input and `sidebar().recent` preserves the original order.

Verified with a six-tag reproduction: the first tag disappears from “recent,” replaced by the sixth, higher-count tag. All four existing tests pass; none checks this behavior.

No files changed.
